ways.definition: Form of way (plural): To do with a place or places.

weak.definition: Lacking in force (usually strength) or ability.

weaken.definition: To make weaker or less strong.

weakened.definition: Form of weaken (participle past): To make weaker or less strong.

weakening.definition: Form of weaken (gerund participle present): To make weaker or less strong.

weaker.definition: Form of weak (comparative): Lacking in force (usually strength) or ability.

wealth.definition: Riches; a great amount of valuable assets or material possessions.

wealthier.definition: Form of wealthy (comparative): Possessing financial wealth; rich.

weapon.definition: An instrument of attack or defense in combat or hunting, e.g. most guns, missiles, or swords.

weapons.definition: Form of weapon (plural): An instrument of attack or defense in combat or hunting, e.g. most guns, missiles, or swords.

weather.definition: To expose to the weather, or show the effects of such exposure, or to withstand such effects.

week.definition: Any period of seven consecutive days.

weighing.definition: Form of weigh (gerund participle present): To determine the weight of an object.

weight.definition: The downwards force an object experiences due to gravity.

welcome.definition: To affirm or greet the arrival of someone, especially by saying "Welcome!".

welcomed.definition: Form of welcome (participle past): To affirm or greet the arrival of someone, especially by saying "Welcome!".

welfare.definition: Health, safety, happiness and prosperity; well-being in any respect.

well-being.definition: A state of health, happiness or prosperity.

well-known.definition: Familiar, famous, renowned, noted or widely known.

went.definition: Form of go (past): To move, either physically or in an abstract sense.

were.definition: Form of be (indicative past second-person singular): As an auxiliary verb.

west.definition: The direction opposite to that of the earth's rotation, specifically 270°.

western.definition: Of, situated in, or related to the West (in any sense thereof).

what.definition: In what way; to what extent.

whatsoever.definition: In any way; at all; whatever.

when.definition: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.

whenever.definition: When ever: emphatic form of when.

where.definition: In, at or to what place.

wherever.definition: Where ever; an emphatic form of where.

while.definition: An uncertain duration of time, a period of time.

whilst.definition: Often preceded by the: During the time; meanwhile.

white.definition: Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.

who.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

wholesome.definition: Promoting good physical health and well-being.

wholly.definition: Completely and entirely; to the fullest extent.

why.definition: Form of wye (alternative): The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.

wide.definition: Having a large physical extent from side to side.

widely.definition: In a wide manner; across a wide area.

widened.definition: Form of widen (participle past): To become wide or wider.

widens.definition: Form of widen (indicative present singular third-person): To become wide or wider.

wider.definition: Form of wide (comparative): Having a large physical extent from side to side.

widest.definition: Form of wide (superlative): Having a large physical extent from side to side.

widowhood.definition: The state or period of being a widow or widower.

wield.definition: To handle with skill and ease, especially a weapon or tool.

wife.definition: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

wildest.definition: Form of wild (superlative): Untamed; not domesticated.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willing.definition: Form of will (gerund participle present): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willingly.definition: Of one’s own free will; freely and spontaneously.

wills.definition: Form of will (plural): One's independent faculty of choice; the ability to be able to exercise one's choice or intention.

wine.definition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.

wine-shop.definition: Form of wineshop (alternative): A shop selling wine.

wine-shops.definition: Form of wine-shop (plural): Form of wineshop (alternative): A shop selling wine.

wisdom.definition: An element of personal character that enables one to distinguish the wise from the unwise.

wise.definition: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wisely.definition: In a wise manner; using good judgement.

wiser.definition: Form of wise (comparative): Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wished.definition: Form of wish (participle past): To desire; to want.

wishes.definition: Form of wish (indicative present singular third-person): To desire; to want.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withdraw.definition: To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withdrawing.definition: Form of withdraw (gerund participle present): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withdrawn.definition: Form of withdraw (participle past): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withered.definition: Form of wither (participle past): To shrivel, droop or dry up, especially from lack of water.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

witnessed.definition: Form of witness (participle past): To furnish proof of, to show.

womanhood.definition: The state or condition of being a woman.

womanly.definition: Considered typical of, stereotypical of, or appropriate to women; feminine.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

women’s.definition: Possessive case of women: belonging to some or all female humans.

won.definition: Form of win (participle past): To conquer, defeat.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

worked.definition: Form of work (participle past): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

worker.definition: One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

workers.definition: Form of worker (plural): One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

working.definition: Form of work (gerund participle present): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workman.definition: A man who labours for wages.

workman’s.definition: A man who labours for wages.

workmen.definition: Form of workman (plural): A man who labours for wages.

works.definition: Form of work (indicative present singular third-person): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worldly.definition: Concerned with human or earthly matters, physical as opposed to spiritual.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worn-out.definition: Damaged due to continued or hard exposure or use until no longer effective or useful.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worship.definition: To reverence (a deity, etc.) with supreme respect and veneration; to perform religious exercises in honour of.

worshipper.definition: A person who worships, especially at a place of assembly for religious services.

worshippers.definition: Form of worshipper (plural): A person who worships, especially at a place of assembly for religious services.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

worthless.definition: Having no worth or use; without value.

worthlessness.definition: The quality of lacking worth, of being valueless, useless or devoid of benefit.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wounds.definition: Form of wound (plural): An injury, such as a cut, stab, or tear, to a (usually external) part of the body.

wretched.definition: Characterized by or feeling deep affliction or distress; very miserable.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writer.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writers.definition: Form of writer (plural): A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrongly.definition: In violation of a moral or other standard, code, or convention; in an unfair, unjust, dishonest, or immoral manner; wrongly convicted is synonymous with wrongful conviction and miscarriage of justice.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrought.definition: Form of work (archaic participle past rare): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielded.definition: Form of yield (participle past): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielding.definition: Form of yield (gerund participle present): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yields.definition: Form of yield (indicative present singular third-person): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoke.definition: Form of yolk (misspelling): The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zealous.definition: Full of zeal; ardent, fervent; exhibiting enthusiasm or strong passion, particularly in matters of religion.

zealously.definition: Like, or in the manner of, a zealot; with great zeal or zealotry.
